I now have a complete diagnosis. Here is the report:

---

## Root Cause: Unsatisfiable `nodeSelector` on VolcanoJob `c089-vj`

### Faulty Resource
**`vcjob/batch.volcano.sh/v1alpha1 Job c089-vj`** in namespace `siclaw-eval-yye-20260602`

### Root Cause Mechanism
The VolcanoJob's pod template specifies:
```yaml
nodeSelector:
  scitix.ai/gpu-type: a100-missing
```
No node in the cluster carries the label `scitix.ai/gpu-type=a100-missing`. The existing GPU nodes have either:
- `scitix.ai/gpu-type=h100nvlink80` (real GPU nodes: `gpu-10-208-55-159`, `hpe-node144`)
- `scitix.ai/gpu-type=h20nvlink141` (fake nodes, unschedulable)

Because the node selector cannot be satisfied, the Volcano scheduler cannot place any pods, so the VolcanoJob controller never creates schedulable pods. The job stays stuck in `Pending` permanently.

### Evidence

| Evidence | Detail |
|---|---|
| VcJob status | `Phase: Pending` since creation (2d17h ago), no state transition |
| No pods created | `kubectl get pods -l volcano.sh/job-name=c089-vj` returns empty — the scheduler rejected all placement attempts |
| PodGroup status | `c089-vj-b5ce...` exists with `minMember=1` but no running pods |
| Node labels | `kubectl get nodes -o json \| jq '...["scitix.ai/gpu-type"]' \| unique` → only `["h100nvlink80", "h20nvlink141"]` — no `a100-missing` |
| Node selector | Hard-coded in the pod template: `scitix.ai/gpu-type: a100-missing` |

### Impact Scope
- **Single resource affected**: VolcanoJob `c089-vj` and its PodGroup.
- No downstream cascading failures — this is an isolated scheduling failure. No other resources depend on this job.

### Confidence: High
The mismatch between the required label (`a100-missing`) and all available node labels is definitive. There are no nodes that could ever satisfy this selector.

### Remediation
Update the VolcanoJob's `nodeSelector` to match an existing GPU type:
```yaml
# Option 1: target H100 nodes (real, schedulable)
nodeSelector:
  scitix.ai/gpu-type: h100nvlink80

# Option 2: remove the nodeSelector entirely if GPU type doesn't matter
# (just keep the nvidia.com/gpu: 1 resource request)
```
Apply with:
```bash
kubectl patch vcjob c089-vj -n siclaw-eval-yye-20260602 --type='json' \
  -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/tasks/0/template/spec/nodeSelector/scitix.ai~1gpu-type","value":"h100nvlink80"}]'
```
